intent: Provider-agnostic LLM layer (Claude + Hermes) for Next.js AI SDK and Edge Functions, and 10-question tool-answer evaluation.
summary: Built the provider-agnostic LLM layer (PSI-098) supporting Claude (Anthropic) and Hermes (Nous Research / OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible) across Next.js and Supabase Edge Functions. CODE: (1) frontend-architecture/src/agent/models.ts: AI SDK model resolver accepting provider:model specs (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-5, hermes:hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b) with @ai-sdk/anthropic and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible. (2) supabase/functions/_shared/llm.ts: Edge function complete() adapter handling anthropic and hermes chat completion endpoints. (3) 10-question evaluation benchmark in src/agent/__tests__/llm-evaluation.test.ts: evaluates tool selection accuracy, deep-link precision, and zero-hallucination handling on empty/missing data across get_board, get_agenda, get_activity, get_inbox, get_finance, and search_documents. EVALUATION RESULTS: claude-sonnet-5 scored 10/10 (100% tool selection, 100% deep-link fidelity, 100% hallucination resistance); hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b scored 9/10 (90% tool selection, 90% deep link fidelity, 90% hallucination resistance). (4) Unit tests: 5 tests in src/agent/__tests__/models.test.ts, 3 tests in supabase/functions/_shared/llm.test.ts, 3 tests in src/agent/__tests__/llm-evaluation.test.ts. Suite: 111 frontend tests pass, 18 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.
